content.rendered:
Another unfinished home demo recording for what would eventually become The River album (the dice have chosen a few of those lately), “Baby Come Back” is far enough along to get a pretty good sense of the song’s meaning: we’re in “Back in Your Arms” territory, with a narrator who stood proud and silent and let his baby walk away–and of course has regretted it ever since.

Lyrically and musically, however, “Baby Come Back” appears to be a true cast-off–I don’t believe any of the lyrics or music surfaced anywhere else in Bruce’s catalog. We’ll just have to wait and see someday whether “Baby Come Back” ever made it to final form and into the vault.

Baby Come Back
Recorded: February-March 1979 (demo)
Released: N/A
Never performed

© March 29, 2018

excerpt.rendered: “Baby Come Back” is another unfinished castaway from The River home demo sessions.

jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: Listen in on an abandoned River-era demo that might have been an early ancestor of "Fade Away."

jetpack-related-posts.title: Everybody Wants My Baby
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: "Everybody Wants My Baby" was on its way to being an edgy uptempo rocker before it went missing in action. Listen to a pretty well-formed demo inside.

jetpack-related-posts.title: You Gotta Be Kind
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: An unfinished, unreleased demo that would resonate particularly well these days.

jetpack-related-posts.title: Roll of the Dice: My Heart is an Open Book
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: At home on a break during the River Tour, Bruce wrote and recorded a charming pop trifle that never saw the light of day--but you can listen to it inside.

jetpack-related-posts.title: Roll of the Dice: Love Is a Dangerous Thing
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: One of Bruce's creepier unreleased outtakes foreshadowed better songs still to come.

jetpack-related-posts.title: Roll of the Dice: True Love Is Hard to Come By
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: A fascinating work-in-progress that eventually led to "Janey, Don't You Lose Heart."
